result.summary: Removed the dead code pair and orphaned type files, retired atendly-directory.css by relocating every rule still used by a live screen into the correct module stylesheet, and fixed CustomerForm's 'Revisar dados' data loss with a proving test.
result.report:
Confirmed via grep that features/calendar/types.ts and mocks/data/appointments.ts had no importer except each other (the calendar screen that used to import them was already replaced by WU-03), and that features/customers/types.ts and features/services/types.ts had zero importers anywhere in src. Deleted all four files.

For atendly-directory.css: read the full 890-line file and classified every selector by grepping each class name against apps/frontend/src (excluding the CSS itself). Confirmed .directory-shell, .directory-main, .directory-mobile-header, .directory-bottom-nav, .directory-skip-link, .directory-disabled-item, .directory-demo-note, .customer-grid, .directory-state-actions, .directory-note-form/.directory-form-status/.directory-note-actions, .directory-dialog-field, .directory-external-feedback and .directory-mobile-primary (plus their responsive overrides) had zero live consumers — these were dropped entirely. Everything else was still consumed by CustomerAgenda/CustomerMemory/CustomerNotes/CustomerProfile/CustomerSummary/CustomerTags/PrimaryGuardianPanel (customer detail) or ServiceForm/ServiceList (services), so I moved those rule blocks, including their responsive and prefers-reduced-motion fragments, verbatim into: atendly.css for the cross-module page/page-header/page-actions/source-strip/loading-skeleton chrome shared by both customer detail and services screens; atendly-customers.css for the detail-hero/timeline/appointment/section/readonly-field rules; atendly-services.css for the toolbar/search/filters/list/row/cell/state-surface/form-card/segmented/active-control rules used only by ServiceForm and ServiceList. Deleted atendly-directory.css and removed its @import from globals.css.

For CustomerForm.tsx: found the bug at the old backToEdit() — it called setPending(null) alongside setCandidates(null), and since the edit form's <Field> inputs are uncontrolled (native FormData read on submit, no defaultValue), the freshly-remounted form always rendered empty regardless of what the user had typed. Fixed by keeping `pending` alive across the 'Revisar dados' click (only clearing `candidates` and `message`) and wiring defaultValue={pending?.name} / defaultValue={pending?.phone} onto the two Field inputs, so the remounted uncontrolled inputs initialize from the last submitted values. Added a new test in tests/goal015-customers.test.tsx ('Revisar dados' preserva o nome e o telefone já digitados) that types a name/phone, triggers the duplicate-phone candidate flow, clicks 'Revisar dados', and asserts both fields still hold the typed values.

Commands run: `npx vitest run tests/goal015-customers.test.tsx` (16/16 passed, including the new test), `npx vitest run` for the whole frontend app (21 files, 166/166 passed), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean, no output), `npx eslint src --max-warnings=0` (clean, no output). No commit, push, or branch change was made; only files inside apps/frontend touched by this unit were modified.

acceptance.criterion: features/calendar/types.ts e src/mocks/data/appointments.ts saíram do repositório
acceptance.detail: Both files deleted after confirming (via grep) their only importer was each other; git status shows both as `D`.

acceptance.criterion: atendly-directory.css e seu @import saíram sem perda de estilo em tela viva, ou a regra necessária foi movida para o CSS do módulo certo
acceptance.detail: atendly-directory.css deleted, @import removed. Every selector still referenced by customer detail or services components was relocated verbatim into atendly.css (shared chrome), atendly-customers.css, or atendly-services.css. Full `npx vitest run` (166/166 pass), eslint/tsc clean.

acceptance.criterion: Tipos órfãos de features/customers e features/services removidos, ou mantidos com importador real justificado no relatório
acceptance.detail: features/customers/types.ts and features/services/types.ts had zero importers anywhere in apps/frontend/src (grep confirmed) and were deleted; `tsc --noEmit` stayed clean afterward.

acceptance.criterion: Revisar dados do CustomerForm preserva nome e telefone digitados, provado por teste
acceptance.detail: backToEdit() no longer clears `pending`; Field inputs now carry defaultValue={pending?.name}/{pending?.phone}. New test in goal015-customers.test.tsx passes (16/16).
